name: On-shelf availability (Global Fund KPI S8 method; eLMIS source)
definition: Share of health facilities with at least one tracer product of a product category available where tracer products of that category are expected
numerator: facilities where any tracer product of the category has stock_in_hand > 0 in its latest report of the month (period-end position)
denominator: facilities that reported a non-skipped line for a tracer product of the category that month
formula: sum(numerator) / sum(denominator) x 100; a disease score pools its categories (handbook step 3)
grain: month x province x disease x product category (facilities counted once per category)
exclusions: products outside HIV/TB/malaria tracer categories; lines with unknown stock_in_hand count as reported but not available
official_reference: Global Fund KPI Handbook 2023-2028 KPI S8 p.79-80 incl. Dec-2024 formula and eLMIS data-source amendment; baselines HIV 85% TB 84% malaria 84% (Round 2 spot checks 2022)
limitation: Availability is period-end stock from eLMIS not a visit-day observation (the handbook permits eLMIS for mature systems); TB not computable - no TB tracer products in this archive; malaria covers diagnostics only (RDT) - no malaria treatment tracer

name: Stockout exposure (tracer products)
definition: Share of reporting facility-product-months with any stockout days
official_reference: Platform KPI - adapted from the Global Fund spot-check stockout concepts; not a Global Fund KPI
limitation: Stockout days are facility-reported; a line with missing stockout_days counts as no stockout

name: Stockout days per 100 reporting days (tracer products)
definition: Stockout days as a share of reporting days
numerator: sum over reports of least(stockout_days, reporting_days) - capped per report so an anomalous line cannot exceed its reporting days
official_reference: Platform KPI; not a Global Fund KPI

name: Months-of-stock band share (tracer products)
definition: Share of bandable tracer lines in each months-of-stock band against the stock policy
numerator: bandable tracer facility-product-months in the band, stock state at period end (stocked_out: SIH <= 0; below_eop: MOS < eop; within_policy: eop <= MOS <= max; over_max: MOS > max; MOS = stock_in_hand / amc)
grain: month x province x programme x band
exclusions: lines with amc null or <= 0 and stock_in_hand > 0 (unbandable); non-tracer products
official_reference: Platform KPI; policy from eLMIS facility types (max 3 months; emergency order point 0.5 months - uniform across types)
limitation: Uses reported AMC; policy is uniform across facility types in this archive

name: Order fill rate (approved vs calculated order)
definition: Share of the system-calculated order quantity that was approved
numerator: sum over reports of least(quantity_approved, calculated_order_quantity) - over-approval above the calculated quantity is not credited (standard line-capped fill rate)
official_reference: Platform KPI - explicitly NOT OTIF (no delivery data)
limitation: Approval is not delivery: says nothing about what arrived or when. Approvals above the calculated quantity occur (up to 36x) and are not credited

name: Stocked according to plan (facility-grain adaptation)
definition: Share of bandable lines between the emergency order point and max
numerator: lines stocked according to plan (see source mart)
formula: as the source mart defines it
official_reference: Adaptation of the Global Fund spot-check SATP concept (central-store measure in the source programme) - the handbook lists SATP as complementary information not a KPI
limitation: Facility grain not central store; no province breakdown in the source mart

name: Reporting timeliness
definition: Share of requisitions created within the reporting deadline
numerator: requisitions created within the deadline (see source mart)
formula: as the source mart defines it
source: bi_supply.mart_elmis_hist_timeliness (existing mart - not recomputed; deadline from seed reporting_deadlines)
official_reference: Platform KPI; spot-check programme concept (reporting timeliness)
limitation: Deadline is a configured policy (reporting_deadlines seed); no province breakdown in the source mart

name: Adjusted demand (stockout-adjusted consumption)
definition: Monthly consumption adjusted for stockout days by eLMIS itself (normalized consumption)
denominator: not a ratio - a quantity in dispensing units
formula: adjusted_demand = eLMIS normalized_consumption; dispensed quantity where that is NULL (demand_basis records which)
grain: facility x product x programme x month
official_reference: eLMIS / OpenLMIS normalized consumption (the source system's demand figure; AMC is built from it)
limitation: Months with any stockout are censored: observed demand there is a floor (demand_censored); 3.3% of tracer lines have no normalized consumption and use dispensed

name: Demand trend (last 3 months vs previous 3)
definition: Change in adjusted demand between the latest three months and the three before them
numerator: sum(adjusted_demand) over the 3 months ending at the anchor month
denominator: sum(adjusted_demand) over the 3 months before those
grain: province x programme (or product), at the anchor month
source: bi_supply.mart_pct_demand_month - computed by the consuming query at the anchor month
period: anchor month = latest month in the data (Aug 2018)
exclusions: series without demand in the previous 3 months
official_reference: Platform KPI; not a Global Fund KPI
limitation: 12 months of history: no yearly seasonality can be separated from trend

name: Replenishment need (order-up-to)
definition: Units needed to bring each facility-product back to its policy maximum
denominator: not a ratio - a quantity in dispensing units (packs where pack size > 1)
formula: greatest(max_stock_months x planning_rate - stock_in_hand, 0); planning_rate = champion forecast P50 (AMC for lumpy / no forecast / not champion); an alternative figure nets the ASSUMED pipeline
grain: facility x tracer product x programme at the anchor month
official_reference: Platform KPI - eLMIS max/min policy (max 3 months; emergency order point 0.5)
limitation: Forecast is one month ahead (H1) applied as a flat monthly rate; lead time is an assumption; no monetary value (price semantics unverifiable)

name: Redistribution opportunity (within district)
definition: Units that could move from over-stocked to under-stocked facilities of the same district instead of a new order
numerator: least(district surplus units, district need units)
formula: per district x product: least(sum(surplus_units), sum(replenishment_units_excl_pipeline))
grain: district x tracer product at the anchor month
limitation: Ignores transport distance, cost and capacity (not in the data); an upper bound on what could move

name: Forecast demand next month (P10 / P50 / P90)
definition: One-month-ahead demand per facility x tracer product with an 80% interval
numerator: p50 (median); p10 and p90 bound the interval
denominator: not a ratio - a quantity in dispensing units
formula: selected method per demand class + empirical scaled-error quantiles (docs/pct-forecast-contract.md)
grain: facility x tracer product x target month (H1)
exclusions: series with fewer than 6 observed months or no demand (eLMIS AMC stays their basis)
official_reference: Platform model elmis_consumption_forecast (MLflow run on every row)
limitation: 12 months of history - no seasonality; only H1 produced; accuracy shown is historical backtest

name: Forecast accuracy (backtest WAPE, bias, coverage)
definition: How far the forecasting method was from actual demand on past months it had not seen
numerator: sum |P50 - actual| (WAPE); sum (P50 - actual) (bias); actuals inside P10-P90 (coverage)
formula: expanding-window fold ledger; holdout Aug 2018 touched once; censored months not scored
grain: fold window x split x comparator / demand class
limitation: Champion rule (not a KPI target): beat naive-last and trailing-3; |bias| <= 10%; coverage 70-90%. Historical backtest performance, not observed accuracy for the forecast months

name: Stockout risk next month
definition: Whether stock on hand covers next month's forecast demand
numerator: facility-product rows with stock below P50 (likely short) or, for critical tracers, below P90 (at risk)
denominator: rows assessed (a live-champion forecast and stock on hand)
formula: likely_short: stock < P50; critical_at_risk: critical tracer and P50 <= stock < P90; no_demand_expected: no stock and no demand forecast; else covered
grain: facility x tracer product x programme at the anchor month
exclusions: rows without a live-champion forecast or without stock on hand (not_assessed)
official_reference: Forecast contract section 8 (decision #28); critical = Global Fund S8 categories
limitation: One-month quantiles (P10-P90 coverage 81% in backtest); assumes the next delivery arrives within the month
